Where does agent "level" / "rank" / "status" / "tier" come from today? **Backend Data Model (SQLite + HR system):** 1. **Core agent fields** (`src/db.js`, lines 187-216): - `level` (INTEGER, default 0) — computed level 0-8 - `lastPromoted` (TEXT) — timestamp of last promotion - `pip` (TEXT) — Performance Improvement Plan notes if any 2. **Experience computation** (`src/experience.js`): - Lines 63-80: **LEVEL_THRESHOLDS** (9 levels: Trainee→Fellow) - Level 0: Trainee (0-1 YoE) - Level 1: Junior (1-3 YoE) - Level 2: Mid (3-5 YoE) - Level 3: Senior (5-8 YoE) - Level 4: Lead (8-12 YoE) - Level 5: Principal (12-18 YoE) - Level 6: Staff (18-25 YoE) - Level 7: Distinguished (25-40 YoE) - Level 8: Fellow (40+ YoE) - Lines 41-48: **Weights** (tunable): - trainingKbPerYear: 10 KB .md = 1 YoE - runsPerYear: 20 runs = 1 YoE - daysPerYear: 90 tenure days = 1 YoE - patternWeight: +0.5 per good pattern contributed - antipatternPenalty: -0.3 per antipattern triggered - successBonus: +0.5 for high success rate 3. **Org Registry** (`src/org.js`): - Lines 86-117: **Registry storage** in SQLite (formerly `~/.claude/org/registry.json`) - Per-agent fields: `department`, `phase`, `reportsTo`, `title`, `tier`, `status`, `level`, `levelTitle`, `yearsOfExperience` - Upserted via `/api/org/agent/:id` PATCH endpoint (`src/server.js`, lines 3763-3777) - Allowed fields: `department`, `phase`, `reportsTo`, `title`, `tier`, `status` 4. **HR Module** (`src/hr.js`): - Manages weekly reviews, training queue, capability gaps, antipattern signatures - Stores witness logs, daily scores, recommendations for PIP/promotion ### B. Sorting in department columns (lines 172-178): - Department head first - Leaders (tier='leadership') next - Then by level (descending) - Then by name 4.
